method: Read-only source review and exact normalized comparison; no native execution, profiling, producer rerun or cleanup.

resolved_findings.finding: Two initial uppercase GEN17 report destinations survived lowercase generation substitution.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both corrected to GEN18 before report/finalizer execution; original sources and correction record retained. The historical GEN17 report still matches its recorded hash. Subsequent remaining-conversion narrative is separately covered by the final current hashes.

checks: Cleanup and table-context extractor are byte-identical to generation17 after generation-path substitutions; all bounded names, gzip EOF/hash/size, archive and source identity, fsync, durable pre-unlink, final review seal and unique raw perf protection remain unchanged.
Numeric extractor adds only the actual callable toFloatFallback target and explicit overlap/zero/inlining limits. It preserves raw caller edges and reconciliation to helper counts/costs.

Remaining-conversion extraction binds the actual raw profile and analysis, retains exact caller chains for fromBits/round/exponent/wrapper/fallback, and separately reconciles incoming call counts and inclusive costs against stage helper groups. Every actual fallback edge must originate at the source-verified wrapper.

Table branch populations remain actual lookup entries minus direct formula calls under the source-proved at-most-one-fallback branch partition. No inclusive-cost subtraction is interpreted as a population.

Finalizer requires current guarded conversion, one-fallback boundary and zero-case native evidence, full same-generation decode digest equality, unchanged tracking rows/state, raw counts and stable actual-worker capture/source bindings.

Report distinguishes positive zero and admitted dyadics from fallback, labels inlined packing as lacking a separate boundary and preserves inclusive overlap and conditional perf limitations. Absent rounding/exponent contexts are not presented as universal zero work.
limits: Independent final raw accounting, evidence membership and producer input checks remain the responsibility of the separate final reviewer. Cleanup may run only after both final diagnostic seals and coordinated quiescence.
